DONE=0

for fname in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  dest="$OUTDIR/$fname"

    echo "[SKIP] $fname already exists ($(du -h "$dest" | cut -f1))"
    DONE=$((DONE+1))
    continue

  echo "[DOWNLOAD] $fname ..."
  for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    aria2c -x 16 -s 16 -k 4M --timeout=120 --connect-timeout=60 \
      --max-tries=3 --retry-wait=5 \
      --allow-overwrite=true --auto-file-renaming=false \
      -d "$OUTDIR" -o "$fname" \
      "$BASE/$fname" 2>&1 && break

    sleep 10
  done
  if [ -f "$dest" ] && [ $(stat -c%s "$dest" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) -gt 1000000 ]; then
    echo "[DONE] $fname ($(du -h "$dest" | cut -f1))"
    DONE=$((DONE+1))
  else
    echo "[FAIL] $fname"
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "=== RESULT: $DONE/$TOTAL files completed ==="
ls -lh "$OUTDIR"/*.hdf5 2>/dev/null
